function zbadge(z){ if(typeof z!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(z)) return ''; return '<span class="badge">legacy z '+(z>0?'+':'')+z+'</span>'; }
function el(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
/* ops 3584 ADDITIVE: Asia tech-pulse (justhodl-asia-leads) + next prints (existing justhodl-econ-calendar — wired, not rebuilt) */
(async function(){
  try{
    var asiaRaw=await JHMacroTransport.load('asia');
    try{JHAsiaCalendar.render(document,asiaRaw);}catch(e){JHAsiaCalendar.clear(document,'Asia calendar unavailable: '+e.message);}
    var a=JHMacroTransport.legacy(asiaRaw);
    var cl={};try{var cj=JHMacroTransport.legacy(await JHMacroTransport.load('china'));cl=(cj.tsf&&cj.tsf.pboc_cn)||{};}catch(e){}
    var gr={};try{gr=JHMacroTransport.legacy(await JHMacroTransport.load('geo'));}catch(e){}
    gr=JHGeoResearch.context(gr); // Dated observations cannot inherit legacy stress/pricing authority.
    el('asia-pulse').innerHTML='<h3>Asia customs, news and order context</h3>'
      +'<div class="note">Legacy text extractions below are unqualified: signs, periods and sources need review. They are not independent evidence or a semiconductor-demand signal. <a href="#asia-calendar">Inspect the separate monthly export series below</a>.</div>'
      +((a.korea_flash&&a.korea_flash.total_yoy_pct!=null)?('<div class="kv"><span>🇰🇷 Korea 20-day flash</span><b class="'+'mute'+'">'+(a.korea_flash.total_yoy_pct>0?'+':'')+a.korea_flash.total_yoy_pct+'% YoY</b><span class="mute"> · $'+(a.korea_flash.total_usd_bn??'—')+'B'+(a.korea_flash.semis_yoy_pct!=null?' · semis '+(a.korea_flash.semis_yoy_pct>0?'+':'')+a.korea_flash.semis_yoy_pct+'%':'')+' · KCS provisional, prints the 21st</span></div>'):((a.korea_flash_tape&&a.korea_flash_tape.latest)?('<div class="kv"><span>🇰🇷 Korea 20-day flash</span><b class="'+'mute'+'">'+(a.korea_flash_tape.latest.yoy_pct>0?'+':'')+a.korea_flash_tape.latest.yoy_pct+'% YoY</b><span class="mute">'+(a.korea_flash_tape.latest.semis_yoy_pct!=null?' · semis '+(a.korea_flash_tape.latest.semis_yoy_pct>0?'+':'')+a.korea_flash_tape.latest.semis_yoy_pct+'%':'')+' · '+(a.korea_flash_tape.latest.period||'')+' · news-tape</span></div>'):''))
      +((a.taiwan_orders&&(a.taiwan_orders.yoy_pct!=null||a.taiwan_orders.latest_usd_bn!=null))?('<div class="kv"><span>Taiwan export ORDERS</span><b class="'+'mute'+'">'+(a.taiwan_orders.yoy_pct!=null?((a.taiwan_orders.yoy_pct>0?'+':'')+a.taiwan_orders.yoy_pct+'% YoY'):('US$'+(a.taiwan_orders.latest_usd_bn??'—')+'B'))+'</b><span class="mute"> · US$'+(a.taiwan_orders.latest_usd_bn??'—')+'B · '+(a.taiwan_orders.period||'')+' · orders and shipments use different source definitions</span></div>'):'')
      +((cl.flow_trn_cny!=null)?('<div class="kv"><span>🇨🇳 China TSF flow</span><b class="'+((cl.yoy_delta_trn||0)>0?'good':(cl.yoy_delta_trn||0)<0?'bad':'flat')+'">¥'+cl.flow_trn_cny+'tn</b><span class="mute"> · '+(cl.period||'')+(cl.yoy_delta_trn!=null?' · Δ '+(cl.yoy_delta_trn>0?'+':'')+cl.yoy_delta_trn+'tn YoY':'')+' · reported financing flow; not a GDP-normalized credit impulse</span></div>'):'')
      +'<div class="kv"><span>Geopolitical news</span><b>Research only</b><span class="mute"> · no score-derived market-pricing conclusion · <a href="/geo-risk.html">Review coverage and publisher dates</a></span></div>'
      +(gr&&gr.top_country?('<div class="kv"><span>🌍 Geo stress</span><b class="'+(gr.global_temp>=45?'bad':gr.global_temp>=30?'flat':'good')+'">'+gr.top_country+' '+((gr.rankings&&gr.rankings[0])?gr.rankings[0].stress_score:'')+'</b><span class="mute"> · temp '+gr.global_temp+((gr.escalating&&gr.escalating.length)?' · ▲ '+gr.escalating.map(function(e){return e.country;}).join(', '):'')+' · news-flow</span></div>'):'')
      +'<div class="note">All Asia fields remain inspectable in the <a href="/data/asia-leads.json?exact=1&amp;nogen=1">complete Asia packet</a>. A growth rate or order total alone supplies no portfolio instruction.</div>';
  }catch(e){ JHAsiaCalendar.clear(document,'Asia source unavailable. Earlier measurements cleared.');try{el('asia-pulse').innerHTML='<h3>🌏 Asia tech pulse</h3><div class="err">unavailable</div>';}catch(_e){} }
  try{
    var c=JHMacroTransport.legacy(await JHMacroTransport.load('calendar'));
    if(c.feed_status!=='ok'){
      el('next-prints').innerHTML='<h3>Next economic releases</h3><div class="note">Schedule unavailable: '+(c.feed_status||'source status not declared')+'. An empty response does not mean no releases are scheduled. Publication '+(c.generated_at||'unavailable')+'. <a href="/data/econ-calendar.json?exact=1&amp;nogen=1">Inspect complete calendar packet</a></div>';
    }else{
    var up=(c.upcoming||[]).slice(0,6); var nm=c.next_major||null;
    var rows=up.map(function(u){ return '<div class="kv"><span>'+(u.date||'').slice(5)+'</span><b>'+((u.event||u.release||'')+'').slice(0,34)+'</b><span class="mute">'+(u.estimate!=null?' est '+u.estimate:'')+'</span></div>'; }).join('');
    el('next-prints').innerHTML='<h3>📅 Next prints — consensus watch</h3>'
      +(nm?('<div class="big">'+((nm.event||'')+'').slice(0,26)+' <span class="badge bd-warm">'+(nm.date||'')+'</span></div>'):'')
      +rows+(up.length?'':'<div class="note">No upcoming rows in this source window; this is not proof of an empty economic calendar.</div>')+'<div class="note">Source publication '+(c.generated_at||'unavailable')+'. <a href="/data/econ-calendar.json?exact=1&amp;nogen=1">All releases and source status</a></div>';
    }
  }catch(e){ try{el('next-prints').innerHTML='<h3>📅 Next prints</h3><div class="err">unavailable</div>';}catch(_e){} }
})();
async function getJSON(){return JHMacroTransport.load('macro');}

function render(d){
  el('macro-complete-original').textContent=JSON.stringify(d,null,2);
  try{JHMacroCalendar.render(document,d);}catch(e){JHMacroCalendar.clear(document,'Monthly research unavailable: '+e.message);}
  d=JHMacroTransport.legacy(d);
  try{ if(d.generated_at) el('asof').textContent='· updated '+new Date(d.generated_at).toLocaleString(); }catch(e){}
  var cgs=d.copper_gold_silver||{};
  // copper/gold
  try{ var cg=cgs.copper_gold; el('copper-gold').innerHTML = cg&&cg.ratio!=null
    ? '<h3>Copper / Gold ratio</h3><div class="big mono">'+cg.ratio.toFixed(5)+' '+zbadge(cg.z_1y)+'</div><div class="note">'+'Ratio units, quote alignment and any relationship to yields remain unqualified.</div><div class="lab" style="margin-top:6px">as of '+(cg.asof||'')+'</div>'
    : '<h3>Copper / Gold ratio</h3><div class="err">'+(cgs.error||'unavailable')+'</div>'; }catch(e){ el('copper-gold').innerHTML='<h3>Copper / Gold</h3><div class="err">render error</div>'; }
  // gold/silver
  try{ var gs=cgs.gold_silver; el('gold-silver').innerHTML = gs&&gs.ratio!=null
    ? '<h3>Gold / Silver ratio</h3><div class="big mono">'+gs.ratio.toFixed(1)+' '+zbadge(gs.z_1y)+'</div><div class="note">'+'Ratio units, quote alignment and original source observations remain unqualified.</div><div class="lab" style="margin-top:6px">as of '+(gs.asof||'')+'</div>'
    : '<h3>Gold / Silver ratio</h3><div class="err">unavailable</div>'; }catch(e){ el('gold-silver').innerHTML='<h3>Gold / Silver</h3><div class="err">render error</div>'; }
  // rate-cut diffusion
  try{ var rc=d.rate_cut_diffusion||{};
    if(rc.net_pct_cutting!=null){
      var reg='UNQUALIFIED'; var c='';
      var rows=Object.entries(rc.by_country||{}).map(function(kv){ var col='mute'; return '<span class="pill '+col+'">'+kv[0]+': '+kv[1]+'</span>'; }).join(' ');
      el('rate-cut').innerHTML='<h3>Legacy monthly-rate classifications</h3><div class="big">'+(rc.net_pct_cutting>0?'+':'')+rc.net_pct_cutting+'% <span class="badge '+c+'">'+reg+'</span></div><div class="note">'+rc.cutting+' cutting · '+rc.hiking+' hiking · '+rc.holding+' holding ('+rc.n_central_banks+' returned series out of 20 requested). Monthly averages are not a verified policy-decision ledger. Cross-country dates and source definitions remain unqualified.</div><div style="margin-top:10px">'+rows+'</div>';
    } else el('rate-cut').innerHTML='<h3>Rate-cut diffusion</h3><div class="err">'+(rc.error||'unavailable')+'</div>';
  }catch(e){ el('rate-cut').innerHTML='<h3>Rate-cut diffusion</h3><div class="err">render error</div>'; }
  el('freight').innerHTML='<h3>Freight activity</h3><div class="note">The inherited average mixes overlapping monthly sources. Read the exact-month Freight Pulse measurements below; the original macro freight fields remain in the complete packet.</div>';
}
getJSON().then(render).catch(function(e){ JHMacroCalendar.clear(document,'Macro source unavailable.'); for(var id of ['copper-gold','gold-silver','rate-cut','freight'])el(id).textContent='Macro source unavailable.'; });
</script>
